settings.title: What we build with
settings.text: Honest materials, chosen for their character and their durability. From richly grained Sheesham to hand-woven natural cane, every material in our furniture is selected to age beautifully in your home.

settings.heading: Sheesham & mango wood
settings.text:
Our frames are cut from premium Sheesham and sustainably farmed mango wood — kiln-dried to a stable moisture content so your furniture won't warp, split or creak as seasons change.

  • Rich, unique grain on every piece
  • Kiln-dried for lifelong stability
  • Finished with natural, low-VOC oils

settings.heading: Natural cane
settings.text:
Breathable, lightweight and endlessly tactile, our cane panels are hand-woven from sustainably harvested rattan. It's a painstaking process that rewards you with furniture that feels airy yet deeply grounded.

  • Hand-woven panel by panel
  • Even, uniform tension
  • Ages with a warm honey patina

settings.heading: Sourced with care
settings.text:
Every material we use is chosen for its character, durability and responsible origin — so what you bring home is beautiful, and made the right way.

  • Sustainably harvested cane from managed sources.
  • Farmed mango wood that reduces waste from fruit orchards.
  • Natural, non-toxic finishes that are safe for your home.
  • Built to be repaired, not replaced — a lifetime of use.
